Title: Basilica of San Clemente
Note:
Really interesting bit of history. First it’s an active church from the 12th century. The church itself is very beautiful and sometimes you can even see the priest doing services there but it’s built on top of a church from the fourth century which itself was built on top of another church from the first century. 

As your step through the various churches, you’re stepping back in time, and you realize how Rome was built and rebuilt, and the foundations were filled then refilled overtime.
